notes.title: DLC Release & Game Updates!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are happy to announce that there is now a brand-new DLC available 🎉
The DLC contains behind-the-scenes footage that can be unlocked in the index of the diary.
We had a lot of fun filming the scenes in the game and hope you all enjoy it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844740/Love_Too_Easily__Behind_the_Scenes_DLC/

We've also listened to your feedback and have made a few updates to the game👇🏻

All mini games expect mini game 8 are now skippable on first playthrough

 Mini game 8 is unskippable as it in an important game to figure out who Yeonwoo kissed. Once played once, it will become skippable.

Mini Game 8 「The Phone of the Person I Kissed」

 Removed unnecessary apps such as Call, Internet, Message, and Chatting
 Users can now only see the following apps: Galley, Taro, and Monstergram

Mini Game 9 「Nonogram」

 Many users have expressed the difficulty with this game so we have change it so the game starts with the left 3 columns painted to begin with

Mini Game 6 「Stalker's Ambush」
There was a lack of connection between mini game 6 and the next video so we changed it to the following: 

 Previous: User can battle with a stalker up to 3 times depending on the user's movement and interaction
 Current: User can battle up to 2 times, and must battle when the user arrives at the destination

Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue where the game was unable to run with locale settings in Turkey
 Fixed minor typos


Thank you for all your continued support!

- Monster Guide

notes.title: 【Update #3】New Features & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Monster Guide Team!
We're back with another update and here's what's new:

🌟New Features:

 Added the ability to skip minigames: Each minigame requires a minimum of one playthrough, after which you can use the skip feature.

🌟Content Updates:

 Modified the requirements for successfully presenting evidence: Previously, you needed to present 4 pieces of evidence, but with this update, you only need to present 3 pieces of evidence.
Escape Room timeout duration: The timeout for Escape Room games has been adjusted to 10 minutes.

🛠Bug Fixes:

 Other minor bug fixes: We've fixed a number of minor bugs in the game.

Thank you so much for your continued support and interest!

- Monster Guide Team

notes.title: 【Update #1】Regional Setting Bug & Skip Function Addition
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Monster Guide Team!

Not only have we fixed the regional setting bug that results in a black start-up screen, we’ve also added in the skip function that had been requested!

🌟Added Features:

 With the new update, you can return to your previous choices at any time.
 After viewing at least one ending, you can skip the scene by pressing Tab.
 Previously unskippable scenes, such as those involving evidence or branching of the story, are now skippable after watching for some time by pressing Tab.

🛠Bug Fixes:

 An issue where specific regional settings prevented the game from launching.

Thank you so much to everyone who has supported our game!

- Monster Guide Team

notes.title: Update Regarding Streaming of ｢Love Too Easily｣
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Monster Guide Team!

We would like to thank you all for streaming 「Love Too Easily」this past week!
As we've received feedback that the previously requested limit of 2 endings is too short, we've decided to revise our guidelines to allow up to 4 endings for a more enjoyable gaming experience.

We are working hard to implement changes to the game based on the feedback we’ve received so far.
We appreciate your continued support - thank you!

- MonsterGuide Team
